title: docs(qa): checklist item for the list column-header menu and the sort-level reorder
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGyo1s5XDjcEx7u8WDqbFTx)_
Fixes #35922

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只是测试清单多了一条列表页检查项(点列标题弹菜单、多级排序调先后),并改正了一句过时的步骤说明。
- 属于列表页重做这一组工作,补上了列标题菜单功能上线后测试清单里缺的那一块。
- 出错只会让测试人员按错的步骤操作,不影响任何用户,可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- New item `records-forms.list-header-menu-and-sort-levels` (P2, browser, since v18.7), placed right after `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder`. It drives the two things #35876 added to the list page (PR #35909), read from the shipped source at base 4e55e4eb:
  - a click on a column header opens the column menu (Sort ascending / Sort descending / Hide column) and changes no sort; a second click shuts it;
  - the entry chosen is the server sort (`sort=-due_date`), and over two levels or more the picked column becomes the first level while every other level keeps its place (`withHeaderSortPick`);
  - keyboard: Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the focused header opens the menu with focus on the first entry; Esc shuts it without touching the sort and gives focus back to the header;
  - a header that does not sort (showcase_task's Project, a master_detail column) opens a menu with Hide column alone;
  - a click on the sort chip opens every level in one panel and never flips a direction;
  - the sort panel's handles reorder the levels by ArrowUp / ArrowDown (the handle keeps focus, nothing happens past either end) and by drag; a single level's handle is disabled.
  It cites the four pins #35909 added as `automated` and an acceptance clause, and anchors `source` to `GridHeaderMenuProvider`, `openHeaderMenu`, `withHeaderSortPick`, `handleHeaderSort` and `moveItem`.
- `ux-conventions.write-feedback` revision 17: `variants[8]` said a click on a Studio Records grid header "sorts the column (QA run #33914)". On main that click selects the field and opens its properties and never sorts; sort and hide are in the header's 'Sort and hide' caret menu. This was made false by #34794 (Studio's capture-phase header handler), not by #35876; #35876 only turned that caret menu into a `role=menu`. No clause changed.

## Tests

No code changed. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` (self-tests and the ledger) passes at 0e001f01, and the new item's seven `#symbol` anchors resolve (1754/1764 before, 1761/1771 after).

## Acceptance notes

- The card listed "add to the existing sort" as a menu entry. The shipped menu has no such entry: with two levels or more a pick puts the column first and keeps the other levels. The item follows the code.
- The record page's related list also opens the header menu (`headerMenu: true` in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`). No checklist item drives that host. Noted here only.
- No live run was made. The item is authored from source, as its history row says.

## Verification

Files to read first, riskiest first:
1. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`: the new item's `acceptance[2]` (the three-level request strings).
2. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json`: `variants[8]`'s rewritten last clause.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs records-forms.list-header-menu-and-sort-levels` resolves the item, and `pnpm check:platform-checklist` prints `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 437 items`.
